additionalFiles.contract.md: The plain application core must remain independent of Spring and presentation. An order and its local receipt must stay atomic. committedReceipt is an observable presentation callback whose invocation means that the effective database transaction has committed. There is no durable message-delivery requirement. ReceiptEntry is invoked without an ambient transaction; its callerTransaction uses the same transaction manager as TransactionalOrders and default propagation. Keep the existing actor trust and access rules.
additionalFiles.migration-note.md: The inner use case returns its immutable Result. The outer entry then presents a committed receipt. Because orders.submit returned, the effective transaction has completed before committedReceipt is invoked. No application-owned callback interface is needed for this one final outcome.
